notes.title: Table for None Demo Update 1.9
notes.notes: [h2]NPC Exchange System[/h2][p]Players can now exchange NPC requirements like gold or food ingredients for station blueprints or cook ingredients[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704789/917cd3e635f28c1edf213c5d5afd5a0c713e5eda.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Table for None Demo Update 1.8
notes.notes: [h2]Video Guide Menu[/h2][p]A Video Guide menu has been added to the pause menu to help players if they get lost while playing through the game.[/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704789/b3d29ae806425760d9e73deaf87f3933fa1bf0e2.gif"][/img] [/h2][h2]Action Bubble UI Indicator[/h2][p]When a player interacts and toggles an action bubble, a UI indicator with detailed descriptions is now displayed.[/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704789/66d31d6c133370bfd5c2446d66d7c5ff812964ba.gif"][/img] [/h2][h2]Guide Pointers for Quest [/h2][p]Guide pointers have been added throughout the game to help players easily follow quests.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704789/f6c2f382c7b1abf162ab8bef385e9d8d7ffe0248.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Table for None Demo Update 1.7
notes.notes: [h2]Background Buildings[/h2][p]Background buildings for shops are added.[/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704789/78c0eee6089ea79bbabfd28520602c19b42cddc2.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704789/8d673051adb2862daa0663cb613f6158e4d1f987.png"][/img]  [/h2][h2]Station Export System Update[/h2][p]Station export and placement movement now snap directly to the available control direction, instead of moving frame by frame.[/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704789/d88b28062751535ee03940d07cb6e4f702df2971.gif"][/img] [/h2][h2]New Station "Neon Sign"[/h2][p]Players can toggle neon lights on and off. Neon signs are customizable based on the player’s current held item. Also, placing and turning on the neon signs increase NPC appearance rates.[/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704789/5f5560e694190d0757f77dceafbf5b47b346787b.gif"][/img] [/h2][h2]Location Arrival Cutscene[/h2][p]A cutscene has been added for when the player arrives at a new location.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704789/8b799362f722b502729e8c54f52749649db2b37c.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Table for None Demo Update 1.6
notes.notes: [h2]Complete Bundles, Unlock Food Stocks[/h2][p]Food stocks are now unlocked by placing and completing each unique food bundle.[/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704789/ef08af00fb91af075929794cc08ad8a9b5ce258e.gif"][/img][/h2][h2]Recent Food Sells[/h2][p]The Archive menu now displays recent food sales data, starting from the right emoji (food order count, sell count, gold count)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704789/e3bb05fd6d6c2a33ef099266f3403690d80112c0.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Table for None Demo Update 1.5
notes.notes: [h2]Buddy Recruit System[/h2][p]New buddy recruit system has been added! Recruit NPCs as a buddy to automatically cook the foods you gifted[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704789/fe4f972457520e64d65d6e842e409439422008e5.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Craft NPC[/h2][p]Craft NPCs can now spawn in all locations[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704789/8fc1d1628694b4792b0dd0a97555cb6135377dec.png"][/img]    [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704789/96f6b93e76cd35f4ae618b66657e2f1924f71d03.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Food Ingredients Toggle[/h2][p]Food ingredients panel update on archive Menu[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704789/1f17dd8c9d5ee9469495d4081d630be793169a37.gif"][/img][/p]
